cases.title: Details header + Analytics tab: name, ACTIVE badge, enrolled counts and sequence cards match DB
Prospects tab: lists enrolled prospects, search filters, status pills carry counts, Export works
Prospects tab: Add Prospects (pick list) enrolls the contact (DB + table); Remove (confirm) cancels enrollment
Subsequence tab shows both steps with approval state; Approve All works; Edit step opens editor
Schedule tab shows queued emails per step/day; Trigger logs shows CREATE/LAUNCH audit events
Sending Accounts tab lists the campaign inbox; Inbox tab renders (empty state) and Sync button reports a clear error with no IMAP
Pause Campaign / Resume Campaign buttons change status (DB + badge)
Send Now: cancel at the confirm sends nothing; accept -> POST /send-now answered and the outcome is shown (result dialog or visible error)
Role AGENT (manage_campaigns by default) can open a campaign by URL
